Traelyx preserves numeric text/labels, reorders columns, pseudonymizes groups and strips clock-of-day. No endorsement implied.
provenance: Publisher version-3 sensor_raw.csv, file e1983622-19cf-404b-9252-0b1efbdf17c7; SHA-256 checked 2026-11-11. Anonymous DriverID/Class/TaskID jointly identify 109 contiguous tasks. Hour/Minute/Second removed after deriving coarse within-task elapsed time. Not user-contributed data.
vehicle_population: Three passenger cars; no motorcycle evidence
device_population: MPU6050 on Raspberry Pi 3 Model B; not an Android smartphone
known_limitations: Experiment only: source coordinate frame and acceleration units remain unverified. Train-only standardization does not establish SI calibration or vehicle-frame compatibility.

Clock granularity is one second, with repeated timestamps and varying intervals. Seven source rows are an index-domain window, not an aligned 5-8 second feature window. Do not interpolate or claim detection latency.
Only three drivers in a small shared hardware/vehicle/route population. Held-out-driver results do not establish route, device, mount or motorcycle generalization.
Four publisher maneuver labels only, with unverified annotation boundaries; no ordinary-driving negative, road-impact, phone-movement or crash label. False severe events/hour cannot be measured.

One predeclared split: driver 1 train, driver 2 validation, driver 3 locked test. One trailing seven-row window per task, with no cross-task windows. Never train on version-2 quarantine or synthetic-only data as field evidence.
